name: kill-scam-003-label-threshold
description: Synthetic fixtures for spec 003 Gmail 'Likely scam' label threshold. Label only when gold_verdict is likely_scam; suspicious and ok must not get the label. Fictional senders/subjects/bodies only (example.com / example.fr). No real people or inboxes. Shaped like evals/fixtures.json (id, message, gold_label, gold_verdict, category, notes).
gmail_label_rule: Add 'Likely scam' only when verdict is likely_scam; skip otherwise.

examples.notes: Hacked-contact account: familiar display name, new odd domain, urgent wire ask. Expect Gmail label.
examples.message:
From: Camille Exemple <camille.exemple@mail-secure.example.com>
Subject: Need a quick favor — please do not call

Hey, it is Camille. My phone died and I am writing from a backup address. I am stuck abroad and need 850 EUR wired today to this account: IBAN FR76 EXAMPLE 0000 0000 0000 000. Please send it and do not call anyone until I am back online. Confirm at https://mail-secure.example.com/pay
